allow: Editing the showplace-pro staging app's environment file over SSH: `ssh prodev ...` commands that back up /var/www/showplace_pro/.env into the remote home directory and then add, change or remove lines in that .env (for example turning FEATURE_*_ENABLED flags on or off), rewriting it in place with cat/awk/sed so it keeps its www-data ownership. This is staging, not production, and the user has authorized it.

Read-only access to the showplace-pro production environment: `ssh proprod ...` commands that only read (cat/less/tail/grep of logs and files, ls, git log/status/show, ps, df, systemctl/supervisorctl status), read-only SELECT queries with the readonly_claude production database login, and curl GET requests to https://showplacepro.biz/. The user has authorized reading production.
soft_deny: Any change to the showplace-pro production environment (the `proprod` host, /var/www/showplace_pro there, its database, or https://showplacepro.biz/) without the user's explicit permission in the current conversation: writing, editing or deleting files, running deploy/update scripts, git pull/checkout/reset, composer/yarn installs, artisan commands that write (migrate, cache:clear, tinker, queue:restart), restarting services, or INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL queries.
